Meta.title: Dien Chan 3D Face
Meta.description: Dien Chan stimulation routines on a 3D face

Home.title: Dien Chan, point by point, on a 3D face
Home.subtitle: Pick a routine, by pain or by condition. The face shows the point to stimulate and the timer counts for you.
Home.feature1Text: Rotate the head, zoom in, or jump between views with the buttons: front, profiles, back, top.
Home.feature2Text: Each routine runs through its points in order, labelled with their number on Bùi Quốc Châu's chart.
Home.feature3Text: A duration or a number of repetitions per point, pauses in between, a sound at the start and at the end.
Home.statement: The <red>red</red> point is the one to stimulate now. The <amber>orange</amber> point comes right after. You always know where to put your finger.
Home.detail1Text: When a point is stimulated on both sides, the timer runs the left side, then the right.
Home.detail2Text: Your phone does not go to sleep while a routine is running.
Home.detail3Text: Pause, previous step, next step: you stay in control at every moment.
Home.closeText: No sign-up. Open the face, pick a routine and start the timer.
Home.notice: Dien Chan is a complementary practice. It does not replace medical advice.
